cyclist_f.name: Cyclist
dialog: Somebody hung lanterns along the humps. Now I can see where I'm flying!
Mind the last one, though. It's a little crooked.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Veteran Grant: I lit every lantern down here myself. Let's see if you can match their glow!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Veteran Grant: Outshone by a youngster! I'll go and trim the wicks.
